trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the resignation probability jump is corroborated by any mainstream news wire (Reuters/AP) or is isolated to the prediction market. Confirm SPY/ES futures reaction direction and VIX level.
time_plan.1h: Assess persistence: is the implied probability holding/rising or mean-reverting? Cross-check with USDJPY and Treasury futures for a consistent risk-off signature.
time_plan.2h: If no corroborating headline has surfaced, treat as noise and fade conviction. If a credible report exists, reassess magnitude toward the lower (more negative) interval bound.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against official White House statements. Determine whether move is sticky or has reversed; update direction if probability has collapsed back.
time_plan.12h: Close window review: compare realized SPY move vs predicted, log whether prediction-market move led or lagged public reporting, and record calibration outcome.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp jump in the implied probability of a Trump resignation would signal an acute, unexpected political-stability shock (scandal, health crisis, forced exit). Sudden leadership-succession uncertainty in the world's largest economy typically triggers a risk-off flight: equities sell, volatility spikes. The magnitude depends entirely on how close to imminent the event looks. A modest probability drift (say 1%->5%) implies little; only a credible near-term resignation signal would drive a 700bps+ equity move. Baseline expectation is a modest negative drift unless the market moves to near-certainty intraday.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify dollar index (DXY) direction and gold futures tick; confirm move is driven by political risk not an unrelated macro print.
time_plan.1h: Check whether gold strength coincides with falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar — the coherent safe-haven pattern.
time_plan.2h: If the resignation probability is fading, expect gold to give back gains; downgrade conviction.
time_plan.6h: Reassess against any official statements and real-yield moves; distinguish political premium from macro drivers.
time_plan.12h: Close window: compare realized GLD move to prediction, note whether the safe-haven bid materialized, log calibration.

predictions.reasoning: Acute US political/leadership uncertainty is a classic safe-haven catalyst. A credible rise in resignation odds would pressure the dollar and boost gold as a hedge against institutional instability. The effect is weaker and noisier than the equity link because gold also responds to rates and the dollar, and a resignation shock's net rate impact is ambiguous (flight-to-Treasuries could cap yields but also drive gold). Only a dramatic, near-certain resignation signal would push gold toward the 700bps tradable threshold.

evidence_used: Market question: probability of Trump announcing resignation by Dec 31, 2026
Resolution hinges only on an announcement, not actual departure, making it sensitive to rhetoric/news
Historical pattern that abrupt US leadership-stability shocks drive risk-off: equities down, gold/dollar safe-haven flows, VIX up
Low unconditional base rate of a sitting president resigning
uncertainty_notes: Base rate of resignation is very low; most probability moves in this market are likely noise or speculative, not information leakage
A 12h window rarely sees 700bps index moves absent a confirmed, imminent catastrophic event
Succession to a sitting VP of the same party could actually reduce uncertainty, muting or reversing the equity-negative thesis
If a resignation signal were already public, the asset move would precede the prediction-market anomaly, breaking the leakage premise

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks the odds of a Trump resignation announcement. A sharp increase in implied probability would most plausibly signal an acute US political-stability shock, mapping to risk-off in US equities (SPY down) and a safe-haven bid in gold (GLD up). However, the unconditional base rate is tiny and most intraday moves are likely noise; only a credible, near-term resignation signal would reach the 700bps tradable threshold. Confidence is low and the mapping is contingent on corroboration by mainstream reporting.
key_assumptions: A material rise in the prediction-market probability reflects genuine news flow rather than thin-market speculation
Markets interpret a resignation shock as destabilizing (risk-off) rather than as reduced policy uncertainty
The move in the prediction market leads or coincides with, rather than lags, public reporting
failure_modes: The probability spike is noise/manipulation in a thin market with no real event, so proxies do not move
Any genuine resignation news is already public, so SPY/GLD have already repriced before the prediction-market signal
Market reads an orderly VP succession as stabilizing, reversing the equity-down thesis
Macro drivers (CPI, Fed, rates) dominate the 12h window and swamp any political-risk signal
Gold's response is muted or offset by a stronger dollar or rising real yields, weakening that proxy
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
